title: The weekend
description: A bilingual lesson in which Mrs. Johnson runs into Mrs. Williams at the greengrocer's and the butcher's, asks about their son Jimmy, who has been absent from school, and tells her they are going to spend the weekend in the country. Includes a fill-in dialogue, a write-the-times exercise and vocabulary practice, plus grammar on was/were and short answers. 约翰逊夫人在蔬菜水果店和肉铺碰见威廉斯夫人，问她儿子吉米（缺了好几天学）的情况，并告诉对方他们打算周末去乡下住。配合教材填空对话、看钟报时和词汇练习，以及 was/were 和简短回答的语法练习。
answer_note: The before-listening question has no official key and its answer is labelled suggested. Workbook A (dialogue) answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 67 key (img/key-063-067.jpg). Practice B clock times follow the printed example (8.05 → It's five past eight) and are labelled suggested; practice C answers follow the printed example pattern and are labelled suggested. Grammar answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 67 grammar key (PDF viewer pages 498-499). No external sources were used.

lesson.text:
Listen then answer this question.
What are the Johnsons going to do at the weekend?
听录音，然后回答问题。约翰逊夫妇周末准备做什么？
lesson.translation: Listen then answer this question. What are the Johnsons going to do at the weekend?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Williams
lines.text: Were you at the butcher's, too?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Johnson
lines.text:
No, I wasn't.
I was at the greengrocer's.
How's Jimmy today?
lines.translation: 不，我不在。我在蔬菜水果店里。吉米今天怎么样？

lines.speaker: Mrs. Johnson
lines.text: Was he absent from school last week?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Williams
lines.text:
Yes, he was.
He was absent on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.
How are you all keeping?
lines.translation: 是的，他没上学。他星期一、星期二、星期三和星期四没去上学。你们身体都很好吗？

lines.speaker: Mrs. Johnson
lines.text:
Very well, thank you.
We're going to spend three days in the country.
We're going to stay at my mother's for the weekend.
lines.translation: 很好，谢谢您。我们打算到乡下去三天，在我母亲家度周末。

lines.speaker: Mrs. Williams
lines.text:
Friday, Saturday and Sunday in the country!
Aren't you lucky!
lines.translation: 星期五、星期六和星期日在乡下过！你们真幸运啊！

lesson.title: Before-listening question
lesson.instruction: Listen then answer this question. What are the Johnsons going to do at the weekend? 听录音，然后回答问题。约翰逊夫妇周末准备做什么？
lesson.translation: Answer the question according to the dialogue. 根据对话回答问题。
lesson.context: Mrs. Johnson says they are going to spend three days in the country and stay at her mother's for the weekend.

questions.prompt: What are the Johnsons going to do at the weekend?
questions.answer: They are going to spend three days in the country and stay at Mrs. Johnson's mother's house for the weekend (Friday, Saturday and Sunday).

items.title: the butcher's / the greengrocer's
items.text: 在英文表示某一种商店的短语中，往往可以把 shop 这个词省略，如课文中的 the butcher's (shop) 和 the greengrocer's (shop)。类似的例子还有 the hairdresser's (shop), the stationer's (shop), the doctor's (office), my mother's (house) 等。

items.title: was / were
items.text: 在英文中，过去发生的而现在已经结束的动作要用一般过去时来表示。“是” (be) 动词的过去式不规则，第一、第三人称单数用 was，其他情况用 were。

items.title: How are you all keeping?
items.text: 这是一句问候对方身体如何的话。

items.title: for the weekend
items.text: for the weekend 是指整个周末这几天的时间，而 at the weekend 是强调时间的某一点。

items.title: Aren't you lucky!
items.text: 这句话是否定疑问句形式的感叹句，为的是加强语气。尽管形式上是否定的，但却表示强有力的肯定。

lesson.text:
参考译文
约翰逊夫人：您好。刚才您在肉店里吗？
威廉斯夫人：是的，我在肉店里。您也在肉店里吗？
约翰逊夫人：不，我不在。我在蔬菜水果店里。吉米今天怎么样？
威廉斯夫人：他很好，谢谢您。
约翰逊夫人：上星期他没上学吧？
威廉斯夫人：是的，他没上学。他星期一、星期二、星期三和星期四没去上学。你们身体都很好吗？
约翰逊夫人：很好，谢谢您。我们打算到乡下去三天，在我母亲家度周末。
威廉斯夫人：星期五、星期六和星期日在乡下过！你们真幸运啊！
lesson.translation: Full Chinese reference translation of the lesson dialogue.

questions.answer: You can buy one at the news agent's (or the stationer's / a newsstand).

questions.prompt: Were you at school last week? (at the office)
Was Mary at school last week, too? (at the office) / Was Jack absent from school on Tuesday? (at school)
questions.answer: No, she wasn't. She was at the office. / Yes, he was. /No, she wasn't. She was at school.

questions.prompt: Was it fine on Thursday? / Was it fine on Friday, too? (cloudy)
questions.answer: Yes, it was. /No, it wasn't. It was cloudy.

questions.prompt: Were you at your mother's on Monday? / Was your sister at your mother's on Monday, too? (at the office)
questions.answer: Yes, I was. /No, she wasn't. She was at the office.

questions.prompt: Was Ann at the grocer's at five thirty on Saturday? / Was her husband at the grocer's at five thirty on Saturday, too? (at the hairdresser's)
questions.answer: Yes, she was. /No, he wasn't. He was at the hairdresser's.

questions.prompt: Were you at the stationer's at twenty to ten? / Was John there at that time?
questions.answer: No, I wasn't. / No, he wasn't there, either.

questions.prompt: Was Ann at school on Friday? / Was Lisa at school on that day?
questions.answer: No, she wasn't. /No, she wasn't there, either.

questions.prompt: Was it windy last week? / Was it rainy last week?
questions.answer: No, it wasn't. /No, it wasn't rainy last week, either.

questions.prompt: Were you at the doctor's at eight forty on Tuesday? / Were you at the dentist's at that time on that day?
questions.answer: No, I wasn't. /No, I wasn't at the dentist's, either.

questions.prompt: Was John at home on Saturday? / Was he at home on Sunday?
questions.answer: No, he wasn't. /No, he wasn't at home on Sunday, either.
